verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a game engine/framework, since an engine could ship an AI assistant or command layer. The evidence documents only a code-first Rust/cargo workflow, and the probe explicitly finds no official MCP or llms.txt. The only related tooling is a third-party community project (bevy_brp) built on the Bevy Remote Protocol, which is a community workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
